title: A Life Behind the Guardian

lines.speaker: leader

journalOverride.title: A Shoot Beside the Core
journalOverride.excerpt:
A small creature emerges and crouches beside Ashmane.
Seeing shoots around the core, the expedition stops approaching.
journalOverride.body:
Even after falling, Ashmane keeps its body low in front of a small creature. The little one emerges cautiously and crouches beside it. The expedition lowers its weapons and stops.

New shoots grow in the light of Ignis. Beyond it lie only long-dead roots. Was Ashmane guarding its power, or this small patch of earth?

People are still waiting in the kingdom. The expedition cannot yet abandon its orders. They take the first core, but record what they saw before continuing to the castle.
